crime: Her mother would warm {WITCH_NAME}'s hands at the stove, then be gone for days, and by morning the bed was always cold again. Whatever warmth {WITCH_NAME} gave, she never took back. To her, warmth that could be taken back had never been yours at all.

Every dusk, a prisoner swam the icy lake and came out blue. {WITCH_NAME} waited on the shore with a towel, the fireside's warmth still in her own body, and took the swimmer's hands. One touch, and that warmth was the swimmer's own.
One evening in the lounge, the swimmer held out her hands. "Take it back," she said. "I want to feel the lake again, and then warm up in the hot showers."

The next dusk, {WITCH_NAME} told the lounge she was going to her cell and slipped out after her to the shore. As the swimmer stepped dripping from the water, {WITCH_NAME} wrapped the towel around her throat and pulled until she was still.
Back at the fireplace, she took the hands of a prisoner who came in shivering from the snowy courtyard and pressed her warmth into them.

After dark, the prisoners found the swimmer on the frozen shore, the towel twisted tight around her throat. In the trial court, they ruled {WITCH_NAME} out: her warmth had held no trace of cold, so she could never have stood on that shore.

But the prisoner she had warmed at the fireplace still felt a thawing ache under the warmth in her fingers. Hours had passed and her own hands were long since warm, yet the ache had not changed. The prisoners understood: the ache had never been hers. It was {WITCH_NAME}'s, from hands still thawing after the icy shore.
fields.epitaph: The swimmer died warm, still holding the warmth she had asked to give back.
fields.epithet: The Warmth She Never Took Back
execution: The execution stand raises an iron hearth-woman, its arms spread wide, and chains pull her into its lap against its glowing chest. Then the iron arms close around her and hold her to that glow, an embrace that never opens. In time, she no longer stirs inside them.

magic.name: Feel What I Feel
magic.text: She presses what her own body feels into anyone she touches, theirs until she takes it back.
